title: Mixtape and Prom
author: Xanthe Pemberton
blurb: Wren Amberdale, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
